newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL- Nordbanken's H1 profit seen lower.
newsitem.headline: POLL- Nordbanken's H1 profit seen lower.

text.p: Swedish state-controlled Nordbanken was expected to post an operating profit of 3.08 billion crowns ($384.1 million) for the first half of 1997 compared to 3.80 billion a year ago, a Reuters poll of 11 analysts found on Friday.
Credit losses were expected to be largely unchanged at 254 million crowns against 260 million crowns a year ago.
For the full year analysts expected an operating profit of 6.22 billion crowns down from 7.43 billion crowns in 1996.
In 1998 the bank's profit was seen at 6.37 billion crowns.
Forecasts for calendar 1997 mean that analysts have downgraded their forecasts by five percent since Reuters last poll which was taken before the bank's first quarter report.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aros, Carnegie, Den Norske Bank, Enskilda, Goldman Sachs, James Capel, Lehman Brothers, Morgan Stanley, Erik Penser, Swedbank, and Ohman.
Nordbanken will release its half year report on August 14.
-- Jorgen Osterberg, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1045 ($ = 8.019 Swedish Crowns)
